notes.title: New demo is here
notes.content:
[p]Hello, I'm very pleased to announce the release of this new demo, which is the culmination of months of work.
- New full-body sprites with arm and outfit variations
- New customization options: outfits, jewelry, more hairstyles and every possible eye color!
- New, more coherent backgrounds
- Extensive staging work to make the result more dynamic
- New, more elegant UI 
- Minor adjustments to text (new choices and a few sentences rewritten to be more fluid)[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]Please note this build is NOT COMPATIBLE with the old saves, in theory they shouldn’t be detected but if they do show up, do not attempt to load old saves it will crash the game. [/b][/p][p]
This is still a demo, so several elements are not yet in place, notably certain mechanics (events and diplomacy). There are also a lot of outfits and accessibility options missing, which we plan to add later. If you'd like to follow the development more closely or have any comments, don't hesitate to join our [url="https://discord.gg/BPsUa6yzyZ"]Discord[/url] ^^[/p][p]
Thanks to all of you for your support over the years, we hope you enjoy all these changes and will be able to wait for the final release of the game! <3[/p]

notes.title: Imperial Grace Kickstarter + FAQ
notes.content:
[h1]KICKSTARTER [/h1]
Hello everyone, if you are part of our community, or follow us on social media, you might already know it but, Imperial Grace will run a Kickstarter !!!

With the money we will be able to

- Get new backgrounds

- Get fullbody sprite

- Create a romance for the Master of Murmurs

...and other surprises ~

Initially, I really wanted to pay everything by myself, but I can’t do it anymore because lifeTM happened. So instead, I decided to see it as a chance. A chance to do all the extra polishing stuff I couldn’t afford and now I am super hype about it!

We made a survey to help us prepared the best campaign we can! (For example, we will probably only have 2 physical rewards and we want to prioritize the one YOU want.)

[b]It takes 5 mins to fill and as a thanks you will get a chance to win an early access game key for Imperial Grace![/b]

[h3][url=https://bit.ly/imperialsurveyks]TAKE THE SURVEY[/url][/h3]


You can also subscribe to our pre-lunch page to boost the algorithm and not miss the early bird rewards discounts.

[h3][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/367138901/imperial-grace-a-medieval-otome-visual-novel]FOLLOW OUR PRELUNCH PAGE[/url][/h3]

Thank you everyone for your support so far, it's truly heartwarming <3

[h1]THE GAME[/h1]
The KS campaign preparation is taking me a lot of time so I haven't write a lot this past two month. But the proofreading and translation is going smoothly, 33% of the french scene are now considered done, and 16% of the scene are translated (still awaiting the english proofreading.) 

We are also working on a trailer revamp, I am excited to show it to you! 


[h1]FAQ[/h1]
[b]Fullbody are cool but what if I prefer the portrait display?[/b]

If our Kickstarter is successfull, you will be able to choose between the two display in the settings of the game! You can change it at any moment depending on your mood a[strike]nd if the character is in underwear or not.[/strike]

[b]How much the game will cost?[/b]

Around 20€

[b]In which language the game will be available?[/b]

English & french. We might translate in more languages if the game is successful.

[b]What plateform the game will be on?[/b]

PC, the game will be sold on steam, itchio and GOG.

[b]What is the game rating?[/b]

The game is rated M or PEGI 16 (not officially tho) because it is intended for a mature audience.

It includes verbal (but not visual) descriptions of violence and consensual sex (optional). The game, especially through the petitions, also alludes to topics that may be sensitive, such as arranged marriage or suicide.

The very detail list of trigger warning is available on our steam page.

[b]Sex scene you say? 👀[/b]

Yes, the game will contain spicy moments with the LI, including a midly explicit sex scene. This sex scene can be completly censored, or just not happen at all if your MC doesn’t want it.

✨Consent ✨ is ✨ sexy ✨

If you have other questions, feel free to ask them, we will probably do a live FAQ before the campaign lunch <3

Take care, 
Ayael

notes.title: 2022 wrap up
notes.content:
Hello everyone! It’s been a rough end of year. Really rough, but some progress has been made! We are now at 148 700 words for the script only, 82% of the scenes are considered written and are awaiting proofreading.

We also begin the programming, not the sprite part, but all the “logical part”, it involves a tooooons of variable since the game rely heavily on his choices and a lot of them requires to keep track on the long run. It’s a very important step, because we need to have a good global vision to make sure the game isn’t too hard or too easy. So yeah, a lot of sexy spreadsheet this month!

Considering the progress, I am fairly confident the french version of the game will be done before the end of 2023, however, translation take a lot of time, especially since we have to wait for the french version to be perfect before starting the translation of a scene. Anyway, those considerations might delay the release at 2024 (especially since I worked too hard on the game to release Imperial Grace in November-December where there is a shit ton of AAA games to take all the visibility).

I have a big announcement to make in January so stay tuned!

As always, thank you for your patience and support, I hope you will have lovely winter celebrations with your friends or family and I wish everyone a happy new year!

May 2023 be kinder than 2022.

Ayael

notes.title: Steam page update and international women's week
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we are pleased to announce that we will participate in the Women's Day Steam Event that will take place from the 7th to the 11th March! We'll have a live stream with a Q&A (if you have any ideas or special wishes, don't hesitate to share them. Otherwise, I’ll just have to indulge in my passion for powerpoints and my endless ability to say how much I love Imperial Grace and how great I think it is) as well as a demo let's-play by the incredible [url=https://www.twitch.tv/reaperbabe7]ReaperBabe[/url]. In honor of the women's week, there will also be several surprise on the social media!

In honor of this event, the Steam page is getting a makeover! Since its creation, we've had some new assets made, such as CGs, and it seemed important to update the content to reflect these changes.

We've also added a link to our [url=https://landing.mailerlite.com/webforms/landing/t8o8z8]newsletter[/url] directly on the Steam page, since it's *the* place to get exclusive content about the game.
 

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40903042/5d480870447d58de4559b7e31b383981c30870d2.gif[/img]
 
[i](The third CG, which doesn't appear on the main page but deserves to be featured, too!)[/i]


Also, we completely rewrote the "adult content" part. We’ve always wanted to be as accurate as possible so as to protect players, but we also realized that it gave the wrong idea to many players, because people tend to always imagine the worst. That's why we chose to put a more general message on the Steam page, and to add a separate document that is more detailed but contains spoilers. Everyone can choose to read through them or ignore them, depending on how sensitive they are to the topics discussed.


Finally, we created [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1652580/discussions/0/3182360420572233790/]an FAQ[/url] to answer reccurent player questions. It will be expanded as we go along.

Thanks again to everyone for your support!
 

Ayael

notes.title: 2021 wrap-up
notes.content:
Okay, it might be a bit early for a 2021 wrap-up but I am soon entering the chrismas-holiday-family hell, and I don't know when or if I will be available later. 

So first, I am sorry but, we are behind schedule. Believe me, it’s even more painful for me, because I really want to get things done, but life happened for various members of the team including me, and it can’t be helped. I don’t want to set up a new tentative release date, because then I will just have to watch it crumble in front of my eyes again, I can just say it won’t be in 2022. 
[b]
Our accomplishments this year: [/b]
- Releasing a demo !!!
- Creating our steam page ; It was… something. Hopefully we had some help from our publisher Abiding Bridge, I can’t imagine how people deal with it alone. 
- Opening our discord 
- Writting 60 308 words for the main story 
- Finishing all sprites needed for the game ; 11 characters with 10+ expression, and a couple of sprites for nameless NPC !
- Finishing the first 3 CG of the game ; the graphist really outdone herself there, they are all so gorgeous.
- Improvement of the outline ; I really had to scope knife this, I am really satisfied now, I feel like I have cut out all the boring stuff. 
- Creating 624 tweets ; I don’t have the numbers for tumblr, but I still wanted to include this here, because marketing is actually very time consuming, and unfortunately it matters too in the production of the game....

[b]
What is planned for 2022:[/b]
- Reveal of the two last side characters of the game.
- Finishing the main writing of the story, I expect ~100 000 more words 
- A couple more CG 
- Completing proofreading and translation of chapter 2 to 5.
- A little update on the demo ~

Also, I decided, I wanted the newsletter to be a cozy place for people who like Imperial Grace. I realized recently, it’s the only place nobody can take away from me so I want to cherish it more. Starting January, people in the newsletter will receive one mail per month, with little gifts, articles about the game (about the lore, the characters, behind the scenes…) or devlogs (I am thinking to do a devlog every 3 month, since I actually don’t like to write them because they take a lot of time...). Some stuff will be exclusive, other just a couple of month early access, I don’t know yet. All of this is kinda experimental, so don’t hesitate to give me feedback on things you liked or didn’t liked. If you haven’t join it yet, [url=https://bit.ly/imperialnew]you can subscribe here[/url]. 

Finally, I have a lot of marketing plans, like revamping a bit the itchio/steam page, doing something cool for #WomensHistoryMonth and keeping posting nice screenshot on twitter/tumblr !

I wish everyone a very happy holiday season, may 2022 be favorable to you!

notes.title: Demo release
notes.content:
Hey everyone, we are glad to announce that our demo is up! 
If you want to follow more closely the development, feel free to join our [url=https://bit.ly/37N0ROj]mailing list[/url], or our [url=https://synstoria.tumblr.com]tumblr[/url]. <3

[h2]Known bug :[/h2]
- Music will still restart every time you reach the hub, I am working on this issue, I will patch it in the next release.
- If you switch between french/english during your playthrough, your registered choice at the end, will be displayed in both languages. Unfortunately, it’s not something we can fix as it’s an engine problem.

[h1]Compatibility with demo 1.0 on itchio[/h1]
[b]For those who played the 1.0 version in itchio[/b], you previous save should be compatible, this updated demo does not bring extra story, but there is still a few extra features for you to enjoy! 

[h2]New features:[/h2]
- Custom your MC, customisation will appear in the textbox and in your new save files !

- Achievements, you can now earn 5 achievements, will you catch them all ? ~

- Add the resource chest into the policies screen so you can display/hide your current resources.

- Add a « skip » button in the hub, it skips directly to the next scene even if you have actions remaining. [Note : I do not recommend using it even in story mode as petitions are really important for the story.]

- Add a « cancel » button in the policies screen so you can take a look without consuming actions.

- Add a new register choice (minor spoiler: dealing with the bastard brother). It’s for science. I want to know how many players are evil XD

[h2]Bugfix[/h2]
- Fix typos and remaining oversight

- Fix the « music restart at every line » problem at the end of some scenes bug.

- Now, notifications appear in the English version too (everyone deserves to know when they lose money)
